headerDisplay: Control BlickDomi Sentry shutters via the mySmartWindow cloud.

fullTravelSeconds.title: Full travel time (seconds)
fullTravelSeconds.description: Approximate time to move fully open to closed; used to estimate position.

enableReachability.title: Mark offline shutters as No Response (experimental)
enableReachability.description: Uses the cloud Active flag, whose meaning is not fully verified; may wrongly flag working shutters. Off by default.

exposeSensors.title: Expose sensors (master switch)
exposeSensors.description: Exposes sensors on shutters that have the module (e.g. Sentry). Readings arrive every few minutes, so tiles may show 0 briefly after startup.

temperatureOffset.title: Temperature offset (°C)
temperatureOffset.description: Added to the temperature reading to correct sensor self-heating (e.g. -3). Humidity is automatically corrected to match. Per-device overrides via 'devices'.

sensorPollSeconds.title: Sensor refresh interval (seconds)
sensorPollSeconds.description: How often to ask each shutter for a fresh sensor reading. 0 = only at startup.

reachabilityPollSeconds.title: Reachability poll interval (seconds)
reachabilityPollSeconds.description: How often to check whether each shutter is online (only when reachability is enabled).

offlineStaleMinutes.title: Stale-connection offline threshold (minutes)
offlineStaleMinutes.description: If greater than 0, also mark a shutter offline when its last contact is older than this. Leave at 0 unless you have confirmed the device reports in regularly, or idle shutters may show as offline.

devices.title: Per-device sensor overrides
devices.description: Turn individual sensors on or off for a shutter. Leave a sensor unset to expose it automatically when the shutter supports it.
